mainEntity.name: Do I need to make a reservation for a kayak tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, reservations are strongly recommended. Tours fill up quickly, especially on weekends and during bat season. Book online through the website to guarantee your spot.

mainEntity.name: What is the cancellation policy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cancellations made at least 24 hours before the scheduled tour time receive a full refund. Cancellations within 24 hours are not eligible for a refund.

mainEntity.name: What type of kayaks do you use?

acceptedAnswer.text: All tours and rentals use sit-on-top kayaks, available as singles or tandems (two-person). Sit-on-top kayaks are stable and easy to re-enter if you fall off, making them ideal for beginners. Life vests are provided for every participant.

mainEntity.name: Is there a weight limit for the kayaks?

acceptedAnswer.text: The combined weight limit is 450 lbs per kayak. If a single person exceeds this limit, we can separate guests into individual kayaks. Contact us if you have questions before booking.

mainEntity.name: How long do the tours last?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most tours run approximately 1.5 to 2 hours on the water. Please arrive at least 15 minutes before your scheduled start time for check-in, equipment fitting, and a safety briefing.

mainEntity.name: Can children come on the kayak tours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Children ages 7 and up are welcome on all tours. Children 6 and older who occupy their own seat on the kayak require a paid ticket. An adult must accompany any child on the tour. All participants under 18 must have a guardian sign the waiver.

mainEntity.name: What should I wear on a kayak tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wear comfortable clothing you do not mind getting wet: yoga pants, athletic shorts, a swimsuit, or lightweight layers all work well. For footwear, flip-flops or water shoes are best. Avoid cotton in cooler weather. Sunscreen and sunglasses are highly recommended.

mainEntity.name: What should I bring on a kayak tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bring a small towel, a reusable water bottle, sunscreen, and any personal medications. A dry bag is a good idea for your phone and wallet - we sell them on-site for $20 if you need one. Leave valuables in your car when possible.

mainEntity.name: Where do I meet for the tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: All tours and rentals launch from 1019 Commerce Street, Houston, TX 77002, next to Talento Bilingue de Houston in Buffalo Bayou Park. Look for the kayak launch area along the bayou.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to sign a waiver?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, all participants must sign a liability waiver before launching. Guardians must sign for anyone under 18. Waivers can be completed on-site at check-in.

mainEntity.name: Are there alligators in Buffalo Bayou?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, American alligators do live in Buffalo Bayou, though sightings are not guaranteed. They are most commonly spotted resting on the banks in the early morning. Alligators in urban bayous generally avoid humans, and no guest has ever had an unsafe encounter on one of our tours. Guides are trained in bayou wildlife and will point out any sightings safely from the water.

mainEntity.name: Is Buffalo Bayou safe to kayak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The section of Buffalo Bayou used for our tours is calm flatwater with no rapids or strong current under normal conditions. Tours do not operate during or immediately after major rain events that raise water levels. All participants wear life vests and receive a safety briefing. The bayou has been the site of guided kayak tours for many years without serious incident.

mainEntity.name: What happens if it rains?

acceptedAnswer.text: Light rain does not cancel tours - paddling in a light drizzle is part of the experience. Tours are cancelled when there is lightning, severe weather, or significantly elevated water levels from recent rainfall. If we cancel due to weather, guests receive a full refund or the option to reschedule.

mainEntity.name: Can I bring food or drinks on the kayak tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water bottles are welcome and encouraged - stay hydrated, especially in summer. Alcohol is not permitted on tours or rentals. Light snacks are fine as long as you can secure them in a dry bag.

mainEntity.name: Where do I park near 1019 Commerce Street in Houston?

acceptedAnswer.text: Street parking is available along Commerce Street and nearby blocks. The Buffalo Bayou Park Cistern parking lot on Sabine Street is a short walk away. There are also several paid lots in the surrounding blocks of downtown Houston. Plan to arrive 15-20 minutes before your tour to allow time for parking and check-in.

mainEntity.name: Is tipping expected?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tips are not required but are very much appreciated by our guides. Most guests tip between $5 and $10 per person for a good experience. Guides work hard to make the tour informative and fun.

mainEntity.name: Can I bring my phone or camera on the kayak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but protect it. We sell dry bags on-site for $20 that keep phones and cameras safe. A waterproof phone case or zip-lock bag also works for shorter outings. Some guests bring a lanyard or wrist strap for added security.

mainEntity.name: What if I fall out of my kayak?

acceptedAnswer.text: All participants wear life vests, so you will float. Guides are on the water with every tour and will assist anyone who falls in. Sit-on-top kayaks are easy to re-enter from the water - guides demonstrate the technique during the safety briefing. Getting wet is part of the adventure.

mainEntity.name: How physically fit do I need to be to kayak?

acceptedAnswer.text: No special fitness level is required. Kayaking on flat water is low-impact and accessible to most adults and older children. Guests with limited upper-body mobility should contact us in advance so we can discuss accommodations. The tours are designed to be enjoyable for first-timers.

mainEntity.name: Can I book a private or group tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Buffalo Bayou Kayak offers private and group tours for corporate events, bachelorette parties, birthday groups, and team-building outings. Contact us directly at BuffaloBayouKayak@gmail.com or (832) 305-5794 to discuss availability and pricing for groups.

mainEntity.name: Are both single and tandem kayaks available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Both single and tandem (two-person) kayaks are available for tours and rentals. Tandems can also be paddled solo. Combined weight limit is 450 lbs per kayak.
